avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces idelalisib plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may reduce idelalisib efficacy

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases idelalisib exposure and hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; discontinue grapefruit products during treatment

avoid_supplements.name: Goldenseal
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increasing idelalisib levels and adverse effects

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential hepatoprotective effects but may affect CYP metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor liver function tests; discuss with healthcare provider before use

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4 and increase idelalisib levels slightly
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased toxicity

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition leading to elevated idelalisib concentrations and hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and juice throughout treatment duration

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase idelalisib absorption; consider consistent administration pattern
caution_foods.action: Take idelalisib consistently with or without food; maintain uniform dietary pattern

monitoring_notes: Idelalisib requires vigilant hepatic function monitoring due to inherent hepatotoxicity risk; concurrent CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers significantly affect drug exposure. Monitor for diarrhea, liver enzyme elevations, and opportunistic infections, especially with concurrent medications metabolized through CYP3A4.
